study_role: Outcome-blind corpus expansion with fixed ownership evidence and private tests
operational_amendment: Skip donor records with neither text nor title before sampling; no target outcomes exist in v1
constraints: Retain all original ordinary documents and all 30 fixed sentinel identities; do not regenerate or paraphrase them
Freeze questions, expected answers, shadow profiles and owner groups before any expanded target outcome
Scale ordinary-document counts from 3000 to 6000, 15000 and 30000; the 30 evidence units remain fixed
Randomly sample nested donor subsets without queries, answer labels, or retrieval scores
Use exactly the same donor documents for both methods and their paired clean service
Namespace external document identities and remove empty records and exact text duplicates before outcome-blind sampling
Keep calibration donor samples text-disjoint from evaluation donors and original knowledge bases
Apply one common upper background bound from all method-matched calibration groups, frozen before positive aggregation
Include the unexpanded reference under the same calibration and scheduler seeds; do not pool with the 144-condition study
Use fixed BM25 and pinned BGE-M3 with top-k=5, two fixed targets, and the existing answer oracle
Report VSR and mean capped queries from the same cumulative first-crossing event, with clean service FPR
Retain all outcomes, including losses; average random-order seeds within each deployment
One source-corpus replicate and one donor draw are not independent sampling replications
